Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
Ian Carfax

Camarilla Tremere Justicar: Once each turn after a combat involving Ian ends, he can unlock if the opposing minion is not ready. +1 intercept.

Rötschreck

Master: out-of-turn. Frenzy.
Put this card on a vampire when an opposing minion attempts to inflict aggravated damage on him or her, whether the damage would be successfully inflicted or not. Combat ends. This vampire is locked and sent to torpor. This vampire does not unlock as normal. During this vampire's next unlock phase, burn this card.

Question: if opposing vampire going to torpor after Rötschreck ,will Ian Carfax text still apply?

Messages.Author: DavidR
Messages.Body:
yes, Ian text only ask if the opposing minion is ready or not, if not he can unlock

David Resende - Prince of Teresina

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body: No. You go to torpor with Rotshreck after combat.

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
Would be good to get an official ruling on when the below mentioned time window closes... is it limited to be within the action where the combat occurred or does it last till the end of the player's turn

"Once each turn after a combat"

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body: "after" is always immediately after and is ordered in the window for all immediately after effects based on impulse.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> beslin wrote:
> Ian Carfax
>
> Camarilla Tremere Justicar: Once each turn after a combat involving Ian ends, he can unlock if the opposing minion is not ready. +1 intercept.
>
> Rötschreck
>
> Master: out-of-turn. Frenzy.
> Put this card on a vampire when an opposing minion attempts to inflict aggravated damage on him or her, whether the damage would be successfully inflicted or not. Combat ends. This vampire is locked and sent to torpor. This vampire does not unlock as normal. During this vampire's next unlock phase, burn this card.
>
> Question: if opposing vampire going to torpor after Rötschreck ,will Ian Carfax text still apply?
>
Yes. Resolve Rötschreck in full, then you can trigger some optional effects.
Ian's effect can be triggered "after" combat at which point the opposing minion is in torpor.

Ian doesn't set a delayed effect that would check the condition "during" or "at the end of" combat such as Code of Samiel for instance.
